title: Choosing the Harder Right
paragraphs: During an audit at work, Farah notices a small error that would benefit her department financially if left unreported, and nobody else seems to have noticed it yet among the numbers.

She considers staying quiet for a moment, since reporting it means extra paperwork and an uncomfortable conversation with her manager. Still, she decides to report the mistake honestly the next morning.

Her manager initially looks concerned about the extra correction work involved, but quickly shifts to appreciating that Farah brought it forward herself rather than waiting for it to be discovered later by an external auditor.
Her manager thanks her for the honesty, even though it creates more work for the team that week. Farah feels that choosing the harder, honest path was worth the temporary inconvenience it caused her.
